Kit summary

Bone-shattering FuryActive
Deals 360% ATK Burn DMG to a single enemy and steals 20% of the target's Mastery RES (up to 2 times per target).
Flame DevourActive
Deals 350% ATK Burn DMG to all enemies and steals 5% Mastery and 5% Mastery RES from them for 2 turns. Afterwards, deals 350% ATK Burn DMG to targets with lower Mastery than self.
Bloodfury War Song Lv.1When casting it, also casts Bone-shattering Fury once and grants all allies 1 layer of Beast Spirit's Protection (+20% Mastery RES and Tenacity, 2 turns, max 3 layers).
Ancestral SpiritPassive
When an Attribute Steal ally deals Burn, Poison, HP Burning, Bleed or Internal Injury DMG, Ulrik gains the matching Spirit (max 4, no duplicates). Each Spirit gives +10% Mastery. 1 Spirit: +30% ATK and Max HP, and counterattacks with Flame Devour when an enemy gains Turn Meter (once before his turn). 2 Spirits: immune to Control and Turn Meter reduction; counterattacks with Flame Devour when another ally is controlled (once per enemy turn). 3 Spirits: gains 1 layer of Battle Spirit (+4% Skill DMG, max 15) whenever an ally steals attributes.
Bloodfury War Song Lv.1When other allies deal DMG to Bosses, gains 2 layers of Battle Spirit and pursues with Flame Devour once (once per ally turn).
Bloodfury War Song Lv.2Units with a Spirit take 75% less Basic ATK and Skill DMG. When another ally causes him to gain a Spirit, that ally gains the same Spirit and the 1-Spirit bonus (30% ATK and Mastery). With 4 Spirits, at the start of his turn Flame Devour and Heaven-burning Onslaught CD -1 turn, gains Mastery RES equal to 50% of his Mastery (cap 150%) and Mastery equal to 50% of his Mastery RES (cap 150%).
Heaven-burning OnslaughtActive
Removes all enemy Deep DoT II effects, then inflicts Wilderness Gaze on all enemies for 2 turns (Burn, Poison, HP Burning, Bleed and Internal Injury DMG taken +50%; other Deep DoT cannot be gained). Consumes all Battle Spirit layers and deals (400% ATK + 50% ATK x Battle Spirit layers) Burn DMG to all enemies.
Bloodfury War Song Lv.3Cast automatically at max Battle Spirit layers. Restores HP equal to Battle Spirit layers x 20% ATK. With 4 Spirits, ignores Shield. If 10+ layers are consumed, also cleanses all Control from allies and removes all debuffs. Wilderness Gaze on a Boss lasts 4 turns. Deals 5% more DMG to Bosses per Burn ally deployed.
Bloodfury War Song (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.

Traveler’s Diary
The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.

If the owner is from Dragon Tribe:
